description: Week 8 retrieval evaluation: 10 realistic NozomKB questions, Keyword Search vs Semantic Search. Fixtures are created through the real API as [EVAL] content, indexed by the real Worker with the REAL embedding provider, and deleted afterwards. Expected sources are fixed BEFORE the run. 'keyword' is what a user would type in Keyword mode; 'question' is what they would ask in Semantic mode.

pages.title: Annual Leave Policy
pages.content: Every full-time employee is entitled to 21 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave must be requested in the HR portal at least two weeks in advance and approved by your line manager. Sick leave is handled separately and requires a medical certificate after two consecutive days.

pages.title: Workplace Dress Code
pages.content: Staff are expected to wear business casual attire from Sunday to Wednesday. On Thursdays smart casual clothing is acceptable. Employees meeting clients must wear formal business attire. Sportswear and beachwear are not permitted in the office.

pages.title: Payroll Schedule
pages.content: Salaries are transferred to employee bank accounts on the 25th of every month. If the 25th falls on a weekend, the transfer happens on the last working day before it. Payslips are available in the HR portal.

pages.title: Account Security Rules
pages.content: Your network account password must be at least twelve characters long and is changed every 90 days. If you forget it, use the self-service reset page or call the IT service desk. Never share your credentials with colleagues.

posts.title: Connecting to the VPN from home
posts.content: Install the FortiClient VPN client from the software center, then sign in with your normal network account. The VPN is required to reach internal systems when working outside the office.

posts.title: Laptop not starting?
posts.content: If your laptop does not power up at all, hold the power button for 15 seconds and connect the charger. If it still shows nothing, raise a ticket with the IT service desk at extension 400 and we will lend you a replacement device.

posts.title: Bicycle racks behind Building B
posts.content: We installed twenty new bicycle racks behind Building B next to the side entrance. Please lock your bicycle and do not leave it in the corridors.

posts.title: Guest Wi-Fi for visitors
posts.content: Visitors can use the NozomGuest wireless network. The guest password changes every Monday and is printed at reception.

posts.title: Business travel checklist
posts.content: Book flights through the travel desk, keep your boarding passes and tell your manager about your itinerary before you leave.

comments.content: Reminder from HR: up to five unused leave days can be carried over into the first quarter of the next year; anything above that is forfeited.

How to get reimbursed: fill in the expense claim form, attach the original receipts and submit it to Finance within 30 days of your return. Approved claims are paid with the next salary.
